name: Battalion Chaplain (Combat)
body:
Live with the troops, fight with the troops, and fight like a fighter, not like a pasty incense-waver!

Prerequisite(s): War domain or the Tactics subdomain, base attack bonus +3

Benefit(s): Once per day, for a number of rounds equal to your cleric level, you are treated as though you have a teamwork feat possessed by an ally within 30 ft.
